source.name: Cittamobi public municipal line pages
notes: Each entry is a direction-specific public line page, not a route inferred from the line code alone.

Only directions with individually verified complete ordered stop lists are transcribed in the main route catalog; the 2026-11-23 three-page index audit found additional directions that remain in pendingDirections.
No coordinates are claimed here. Geocoding and geographic validation remain pending.
Municipal operator classification comes from the Cittamobi page label and should be cross-checked against the Prefeitura list.

Cross-check 2026-11-16: BB and RALIP public Barueri municipal operator indexes were reviewed against the current Cittamobi two-page index and the Prefeitura terminal tables. A553 is an operator-index-only candidate with a 404 individual page and remains incomplete.

The Prefeitura terminal tables currently list 42 distinct municipal codes; A162, A216C1, A631, T249, T253VP1, T651, T652 from the 49-code Cittamobi municipal inventory are not present in those terminal tables. The Prefeitura page is organized by terminal, so these absences require follow-up and are not proof of service cancellation or intermunicipal classification.

Historical note superseded by the later 2026-11-23 recheck: the public Cittamobi Barueri index resolves to three pages and 150 unique municipal-labelled direction cards across 49 confirmed municipal codes plus the unverified A267 candidate. Three newly verified directions were added; 32 indexed direction pages remain pending or stale.

2026-11-23 operator audit: BB Transporte's Barueri index still lists A553, but its linked individual route page returns HTTP 404; A553 is absent from the current Cittamobi index and Prefeitura terminal tables, so it remains an unverified operator-index candidate. RALIP's current municipal section lists its Barueri municipal services; its 463TRO entry is metropolitan and excluded. The Prefeitura page still identifies BB Transporte e Turismo LTDA and RALIP Transportes Rodoviários LTDA as the municipal concessionaires.

2026-11-23 Prefeitura cross-check: the official terminal tables still list 42 distinct municipal line codes. The seven Cittamobi codes absent from those terminal tables remain A162, A216C1, A631, T249, T253VP1, T651 and T652; absence from terminal tables is not proof of cancellation or intermunicipal classification.

2026-11-23 targeted route audit: refreshed the current individual pages and dated timetable metadata for A160 variants, A168 Jd. Itaquiti via Campos Sales (Baia), A217, T249, T652 and T245 Tamboré (Inajá). The A160 Vale do sol via Zelia page reports 28 stops while the extracted ordered list exposes 27; its existing record is flagged incomplete pending recovery of the missing stop. No coordinates were added.

2026-11-23 three-page coverage correction: page=3 is directly accessible and contains 27 municipal-labelled direction cards. Page 1 and page 2 overlap on A166C1/A166C2, giving 150 unique municipal-labelled direction cards across the three pages.

2026-11-23 coverage gap: three newly verified complete directions were added (T651 Engenho Novo via Brigadeiro Jordão, 17 stops; T651 Engenho Novo, 26 stops; T256 Pq. Ecológico, 2 stops), resulting in 118 route records and 3,640 stop records. Thirty-two other indexed direction pages remain in pendingDirections.

2026-11-23 new code candidate A267: four Cittamobi pages are labelled Benfica Municipal - Barueri, but A267 is absent from the current BB Barueri operator index and Prefeitura terminal tables. Keep A267 outside the confirmed municipalLineCodes and routing-ready catalog pending official classification.

2026-11-23: A212 Jardim Gabriela is now included in the main catalog after transcription of all 49 ordered stops from its individual Cittamobi page. Its 2026-11-19 timetable table contains no published times or frequencies.

2026-11-23 operator-index cross-check: the official BB/Benfica Barueri page lists A212 (Terminal Barueri / Jardim Gabriela) and A553 (Rua Braz Cubas / Terminal Pq. Imperial) among its Barueri lines. A553 is now classified as a confirmed municipal operator-index discovery, but remains incomplete because its individual itinerary is unavailable.

2026-11-23 targeted audit of BBTT/Cittamobi: T154 (both directions), T256 (current Terminal Barueri and Complexo Empresarial directions), T131 Term. Barueri and T412 Jd. Belval were confirmed already present in catalog. Their timetable metadata was refreshed where current individual-page evidence dated 2026-11-21 was available. T242 Terminal Barueri's 39-stop list was reconciled to the current individual Cittamobi page; repeated stop at Estrada Municipal Antônio João preserved. No new IDs added.
